openings.claim: An ordered digest-boundary ledger can locate supported divergence while preserving intervals wherever preceding evidence is missing or incomparable.
openings.delta: Change the ordering dependency from local timestamps to manifest-defined expected stage boundaries; carry evidence in a scripted table joining record identifiers, stage, input/output digests and availability. Compare corresponding recorded boundaries. Report a definite earliest stage only when supplied records establish its mismatch and preceding applicable boundaries are equal; otherwise report the unresolved interval after the last established equality through the first established mismatch. Keep explanations separate. Blank warnings supply no execution evidence.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, timestamp-sorted review, the ledger should avoid advancing the anomalous export record ahead of parse solely because of its timestamp. Missing transform outputs or removed records should widen uncertainty rather than establish skipped execution. These are workflow predictions, not measured improvements.
openings.probe: Freeze both variants on the two disjoint three-pair subsets using the sixty-minute analysis allocation and twenty additional comparison minutes. Use scripts for indexing and record comparisons; log every manual record inspection, capped at twelve per pair across both variants. Resolve record-linked disagreements within that shared cap; otherwise freeze an interval. Before final freezing apply the stipulated transform-record removals and retain manifest discrepancies. Open the two sealed answer sheets only afterward; compare supported claims, interval containment of injected boundaries, and inspection counts. For each output include record references and an available-record digest/identifier check, or state that the missing boundary cannot be checked with supplied records.
assumptions: The dictionary permits corresponding artifact boundaries to be identified; if correspondence is ambiguous, preserve an interval.
Expected manifest order does not prove actual execution chronology or causal linkage.

Defeat conditions include unsupported definite claims, intervals excluding injected boundaries, or exceeding the shared inspection/time limits. Automation setup or ambiguous boundaries may consume available capacity; no guaranteed discrimination is claimed.

assessment: Probe a bounded review workflow, not deployment. Earliest supported divergence can remain an interval; answer sheets evaluate the frozen workflow without supplying pre-freeze evidence.
